name: Food Sale
summary: The locked food-sale layout: eight stacked zones, three treatments, black CTA bar last. Reproduced from ~124 exemplars.

palette.note: Burlington's purple is the named palette 'burlington-purple' and is the default for masjid 1 only. Every other tenant gets a cool/neutral gradient derived from theme_settings.

slots.name: title
slots.label: Dish name
slots.help: Two lines at 107px. Longer names shrink to fit rather than wrap to three.

slots.name: ingredients
slots.label: Ingredients
slots.default: Rice, Chicken, Onions, Garlic and Spices
slots.help: Comma-separated, no 'Ingredients:' prefix — the originals never label it.

slots.name: when
slots.label: When it is served
slots.help: Pickup day and moment, e.g. "Friday (June 5th), After Juma'a Prayer".

slots.name: photo
slots.label: Dish photo
slots.help: Cut out (transparent PNG) reads best against the gradient; a square crop also works. Contained, never cropped by the template.

slots.name: price
slots.label: Price
slots.help: Includes the unit — "$8 Each", "$25 Per Tray".

slots.name: disclaimer
slots.label: Where the money goes
slots.help: Deliberately different on every flyer. Ask the masjid each time; never carry the last one forward.

slots.name: deadline
slots.label: Order deadline
slots.default: All orders must be placed by 11 am Friday
slots.help: The cut-off, not the pickup time — those are different lines on purpose.

slots.name: cta
slots.label: Call to action (phone number)
slots.help: Ask which number to use — the food-order line and the events/RSVP line are not interchangeable. Never infer one from past flyers.
